artifacts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Age of Fronts game asset, painted realistic 2D strategy icon, genuine transparent alpha.
Style: realistic hand-painted finish matching the supplied reference, muted olive-drab, grey industrial metal, restrained warm material highlights, subtle weathering, sharp readable outline. No cartoon cel shading or technical blueprint.
Camera: STRICT TOP DOWN orthographic view. No isometric tilt, perspective, angled camera or large visible side elevation.
Constraints: ONE complete centered subject only, generous transparent margin, no text, symbols, logos, numbering, people or watermark. The background outside the asset is genuinely transparent, not white, black or painted checkerboard.
Input image 1 is STYLE AND FACING REFERENCE ONLY: retain the top-down longitudinal silhouette, weathered painted metal, tidy isolated presentation and nose-up orientation. Create an entirely different long ballistic rocket.
Primary request: one generic ICBM-style military rocket game icon, square 627 x 627 PNG, exterior only.
Subject: one long narrow pale-grey missile, a smooth dark olive pointed conical nose, clean cylindrical long body with restrained exterior panel bands, a short darker olive lower section, small conventional symmetrical tail stabilizers and a closed dark base. Visually taller and slimmer than the aerial bomb reference. Subtle aluminium edge wear and soft upper-surface highlight. No launched exhaust or detached parts.
Composition: see the full LONGITUDINAL silhouette from straight above while the rocket is aligned in the image plane, nose pointing up, tail down, centered, occupying about 84 percent of image height, generous transparent margin. Symmetrical top plan, fins depicted in correct overhead projection. No end-on circular view, no side-perspective view.
Avoid: open internal sections, cutaways, diagrams, specifications, actual weapon branding, readable serial markings or decals.
